takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The shelter sent me an update this morning.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: So it went through?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Yeah. They sent a photo, but I still haven't picked a name.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Let me see. Hold on—look at this one.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: That's a golden retriever. You actually got one.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] That's a golden retriever. You actually got one.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] That's a golden retriever. You actually got one.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Did you check whether that payment showed up yet?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I'm looking. The electric bill's due tomorrow, and yesterday the account was short.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I thought the payment wasn't supposed to clear until later this week.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Hold on, I'm opening the app. My phone just sent a banking alert.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It cleared. The payment cleared.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] It cleared. The payment cleared.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] It cleared. The payment cleared.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: How's your first day going?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Pretty smooth. I've been bringing water so I don't buy soda during the day.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: We've got a break room downstairs. Come on, I'll show you.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Okay. Oh—you mean this cooler? Go ahead, open it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It's all Dr. Pepper. I'm never going to stop drinking it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] It's all Dr. Pepper. I'm never going to stop drinking it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] It's all Dr. Pepper. I'm never going to stop drinking it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I can't find the tea filters anywhere.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I saw them in the next aisle, I think.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I've looked all along this side.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: They're behind you, down there beside that low shelf.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Of course they're right next to the shelf.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] Of course they're right next to the shelf.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] Of course they're right next to the shelf.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: My current medication's getting less reliable. My prescriber wants to switch me.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Has the clinic heard back about the coverage request?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: They sent it in last week, but my portal still hasn't shown a decision.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I'm here. Refresh it while we're on the phone.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It just posted. The covered replacement is the medication I stopped years ago.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] It just posted. The covered replacement is the medication I stopped years ago.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] It just posted. The covered replacement is the medication I stopped years ago.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I found this unlabeled tape in the box with the old family files.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Could it be the old house? Or the backyard?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I just started it. That's you, and there's your dad by the fence.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: They're playing catch now. Hold on—let it keep going.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The ball just came straight into the camera. Dad threw it right at whoever was filming.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] The ball just came straight into the camera. Dad threw it right at whoever was filming.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] The ball just came straight into the camera. Dad threw it right at whoever was filming.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Have you heard back about the operations coordinator job?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Not yet. After the interview, they asked for my references.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It'd cover rent and bills, at least. More than most of the things you used to sketch out.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Wait, you've got a new email from them. Open it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Operations coordinator. Fifty-eight thousand a year.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] Operations coordinator. Fifty-eight thousand a year.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] Operations coordinator. Fifty-eight thousand a year.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Did you make it home from the bar okay?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Eventually. I found my phone and card this morning.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Check the bar charge. Maybe the receipt will tell you how the night ended.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I've got the transaction open. Here's the itemized receipt.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The tip line is blank.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] The tip line is blank.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] The tip line is blank.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Can you still make it to the gym tonight?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I held off eating so I could work out first, then rushed down a sandwich and a protein shake.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: You might want to head over now. They're close to closing.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I'm at the entrance. There's a notice on the door.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It says the gym already closed.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] It says the gym already closed.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] It says the gym already closed.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Chemistry grades were supposed to be up today.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I can see the grade portal on my phone.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Don't say anything yet. Let me find it first.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I opened the chemistry test. It says 95 out of 100.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Ninety-five.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] Ninety-five.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] Ninety-five.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: How've the interviews been going?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: This was my third one this month.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Everything you've heard from them has sounded encouraging.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Hang on, there's a new message from the employer. I'm opening it now.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: They're asking me to schedule another interview next week.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] They're asking me to schedule another interview next week.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] They're asking me to schedule another interview next week.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: School starts in three days. I've got my supplies and timetable ready.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Did you check the first-day schedule on the portal?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Just the timetable. I figured the rest would be there when we got in.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: There's a new notice at the top. Open it—it says something about the opening assembly.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Every student has to introduce themselves onstage at the opening assembly.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [laughs] Every student has to introduce themselves onstage at the opening assembly.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] Every student has to introduce themselves onstage at the opening assembly.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I've been putting a little aside for Antarctica whenever I can.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: How close are you getting?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: At this rate, it still feels a long way off.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I just found an Antarctica expedition grant. It covers the whole trip, but the application closes tonight.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Tonight. A full trip, and the application has to be in tonight.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] Tonight. A full trip, and the application has to be in tonight.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] Tonight. A full trip, and the application has to be in tonight.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The cake was on the counter when I left the kitchen. Now the stand's empty.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Has anybody been in the house since you finished it?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Maya left early for school. I've messaged her twice, but she hasn't answered.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Her phone's under this chair. There's a new photo notification—look, it's Maya carrying the cake into the school fair.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: She took the whole cake to the school fair.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] She took the whole cake to the school fair.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] She took the whole cake to the school fair.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Mia fell off the climbing frame at the park.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Is she hurt? Does she need anything?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: She stopped crying, but she hasn't said much since.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Mia, come here. Open your mouth for Mum.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Okay. Let's call the dentist.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] Okay. Let's call the dentist.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] Okay. Let's call the dentist.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Have you checked our ticket yet?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I'm on the official checker, but it's still loading.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The lottery posted all the winning numbers a few minutes ago.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Try refreshing it again. The results should be there now.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It says our ticket won the top prize.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] It says our ticket won the top prize.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] It says our ticket won the top prize.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I've been doing short obedience sessions with Max every day.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Which commands are starting to stick?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: He's been leaving food alone when I say "leave it," at least when I'm right there.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Max is heading for the snack on the counter.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: He just took it. I thought he'd learned "leave it."

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] He just took it. I thought he'd learned "leave it."

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] He just took it. I thought he'd learned "leave it."

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Do you still want to go out tomorrow?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Yeah, I was thinking of Marlowe's.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Did you make the reservation yet?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Hang on, Marlowe's just sent me a message.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: They're closed tomorrow.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] They're closed tomorrow.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] They're closed tomorrow.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: After today, I could really go for a Blizzard. Want to stop at Dairy Queen?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I've been thinking about one all afternoon.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The parking lot's almost empty. Maybe we're late.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: The hours are hard to read from here. Can you check the door?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It's locked. The notice says they closed at nine.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] It's locked. The notice says they closed at nine.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] It's locked. The notice says they closed at nine.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Are you still following the latest figures?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: The cafés downtown have been busy, and the new warehouse is hiring again.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The central bank's announcement is due at noon.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: My mortgage paperwork is waiting, so I set an alert for it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Your phone says the central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [sighs] Your phone says the central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] Your phone says the central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Everyone's getting here after work, right?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Yeah. And I brought you something.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: You didn't have to. We weren't doing presents.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I know. Here—open this before everybody gets here.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: You got me this?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] You got me this?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] You got me this?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Have you opened the presents yet?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Most of them. Mom told me to save this last package.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: She'd been writing down things you'd mentioned wanting all year.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: It's the headphones. With the books and the sweater, that's the whole list.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: She got every single thing I mentioned.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] She got every single thing I mentioned.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] She got every single thing I mentioned.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: Are we packed, or are we still looking for something?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: I'm checking the bag against the list. Most of it's in here.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I don't see the charger. Could it still be out?

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Wait—I'm checking the side pocket. Hang on.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: The charger's here. Everything on the list is packed.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] The charger's here. Everything on the list is packed.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [groans] The charger's here. Everything on the list is packed.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I still haven't gotten the confirmation for our trip.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Maybe the booking went through and the email's just late?

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: I hope so. Next week is completely open otherwise.

takes.speaker: B
takes.text: Wait, a confirmation email just came in. Open it.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: It's for next week.

takes.speaker: A
takes.text: [gasps] It's for next week.
